asked.item: collaborators work on single image posts

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that collaborators are not supported on carousels, give the same error text, explain why, and say they work on single image posts.

steps.text: Collaborators are not supported on carousels (multi-image or multi-video posts) through Blotato, and the post fails with an error like the one you saw.
Collaborator tagging works on single image posts and reels.
Instagram applies a collaborator tag to a carousel as a single unit, not to each photo or video inside it.
If you need a collaborator on a carousel, publish the carousel through Blotato without collaborators, then open the Instagram app and add the collaborator to the published post.
